scope: RECORD-ONLY production release of vectorized-producer records, admitted alongside original-producer records into A15 assembly. No timing, clock, D4(b), deciding-measurement, heldout or T6 use.

required_changes.R16-3: Before the FIRST vectorized registration, replace the running original-only verifier with the mixed verifier. Otherwise the first vectorized output suspends the queue.
required_changes.R16-1: Before A1, run a production-load byte-exact audit of the vectorized worker, analogous to R13-3 and enforced in admission. Coordinator addition: at least 4 matches across at least 3 epochs, chosen from vectorized production outputs by a hash rule pre-committed before selection, each re-captured on the ORIGINAL worker and compared byte-exact on every record stream.
required_changes.R16-2: Before A1, adopt the reviewer's six discriminating tests.

disclosed_limit: Equivalence is sample-based: no match is individually checked against an original capture. The evidence is A14 (e1 all 64 matches, plus e3/e20 samples), 3 whole-match qualifications, and the R16-1 production audit. Scoring never reads the availability field.
